vendors.name: Aerial Advertising Services
vendors.location: Livermore, CA (registration addresses in Livermore and San Jose)
vendors.services: Letter banners, aerial billboards, logo boards, political and personal messages
vendors.notes: FAA registry lists 4 aircraft: N7589F (Champion 7KCAB), N5832J (Cessna 172N), N8025T, N126TW.
vendors.evidence: N5832J was detected by ADS-B loitering over SF on days with public sightings of Apify (Jun 30–Jul 2, Oct 5), Paid (Sep 15–16), Monaco and Pocket FM (Sep 17–22). Brand matches are inferred from same-day posts, not confirmed by the operator.
